planner: K=8 occurrence shortlist; for each branch value run only raw GF(5) compression plus one exact affine-consequence/parameterization round; score resulting guard-component topology; do not run full feedback closure or Boolean enumeration during planning.
result: One feedback round is neither a safe proxy for full branch consequence nor an economic improvement on this panel. On compiler_0 it ranks a materially worse partition sequence, expanding the verified search from 7 states/depth 2 to 29 states/depth 5; on compiler_1 it preserves the 3-state tree while adding planning work.
related_negative: Raw GF(5) compression without Boolean-guard feedback gave identical predicted root topology for every tested value of each top-8 candidate on all four preserved controls, so an even cheaper linear/topological proxy is blind on those probes.
research_consequence: Stop increasing exact child work inside the planner. The next candidate selector should use partition-stable features learned/proved outside the current child solve, then be frozen and tested prospectively under renaming and SAT/UNSAT controls.
scope_boundary: The balanced controls were not adaptively run with this one-round policy after the compiler_0 counterexample already falsified the intended improvement. This is not a lower bound on all partial-feedback predictors.
claim_ceiling: Bounded negative result for this exact planner only. No P-vs-NP conclusion and no Hodge evidence transfer.
